```{r}
# Import packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Import data
ghg <- read.csv(here("data", "ers_plan_global", "DATA", "ers_plan_global_v5_5_0.csv"))

glimpse(ghg)

power_emissions <- read.csv(here("data", "DATA", "power", "electricity-generation_emissions_sources_v5_5_0.csv"))

glimpse(power_emissions)



# Residential vs non-residential for power
non_residential <- read.csv(here("data", "DATA", "buildings", 
                             "non-residential-onsite-fuel-usage_emissions_sources_v5_5_0.csv"))

glimpse(non_residential)

residential <- read.csv(here("data", "DATA", "buildings", 
                             "residential-onsite-fuel-usage_emissions_sources_v5_5_0.csv"))

glimpse(residential)

```
